_about: Which fal model each kind of generation uses, what gets sent, where the result is in the answer, and the estimated price. Prices change: before a big batch, check the model's page on fal.ai/models. Input values starting with $ are filled in by gen.mjs: $prompt, $image (an uploaded picture), $aspect, $seconds, $ms (seconds x 1000), $loop. A key whose $value is not set is left out. 'output' lists where to look in fal's answer, first match wins; gen.mjs also searches the whole answer for a file link if none match.

style.label: style picture
style.notes: Text to image. Strong at painted and stylised game looks. One request per picture so each file has one cost.

frames.label: keyframe in the chosen style
frames.notes: Image edit anchored on the chosen style frame (--from). The anchor holds the look far better than words.

image.label: picture
image.notes: Plain text to image, your prompt as written.

edit.label: edited picture
edit.notes: Change one picture with an instruction ("make it night", "remove the tree").

texture.label: tileable texture
texture.notes: Square, flat light, seen from above. Check the edges tile before using it; fix seams in code (mirror or blend) if needed.

video.label: video clip (for mood only)
video.notes: Image to video. For mood and pacing only: the motion it invents is often wrong for your game. 5 s is about $0.79.

sfx.label: sound effect
sfx.notes: ElevenLabs sound effects through fal. Add --loop for ambience that repeats.

music.label: music track
music.notes: ElevenLabs music through fal, instrumental. About $0.60 a minute.

model3d.label: 3D model (.glb)
model3d.price_note: Not confirmed: fal lists $0.05 per unit and what a unit is was not checked. This estimate is on the safe side.
model3d.notes: Image to 3D. Use a picture of ONE object on a plain background (--cutout removes the background first). Other options on fal: fal-ai/hunyuan-3d/v3.1/rapid/image-to-3d, tripo3d/p2/image-to-3d.

cutout.label: background removal
cutout.price_note: Not confirmed against fal's price list.
cutout.notes: Used by model3d --cutout. Alternatives: fal-ai/imageutils/rembg, pixelcut/background-removal.
